title: Null dereference in Necko HTTP channel during background DNS resolution timeout
description: When an HTTP connection request encounters a DNS resolution timeout while the tab is being closed, nsHttpChannel::OnStopRequest dereferences a null mDNSTask pointer causing a crash in xul.dll with EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION.
fix_patch_summary: Added explicit null check for mDNSTask before calling CompleteResolution() and ensured cancellation listener unregisters during channel abort.

title: DOM AudioContext thread deadlock during rapid media stream pause and resume
description: Calling AudioContext.suspend() and resume() rapidly across Web Audio nodes deadlocks the graph rendering thread waiting on mGraphLock mutex when audio hardware clock changes frequency.
fix_patch_summary: Refactored lock hierarchy in MediaStreamGraphImpl; replaced blocking mutex wait with non-blocking try_lock and asynchronous state queue.

title: Memory leak in Spidermonkey IonMonkey JIT compiler with recursive generator closures
description: IonMonkey optimization fails to sweep unused bytecode scope objects for nested ES6 generators, resulting in cumulative heap exhaustion under long-running Single Page Applications.
fix_patch_summary: Added explicit GC tracing hook for GeneratorScript environment objects during generational garbage collection sweep phase.

title: TLS 1.3 handshake timeout on high-latency mobile networks due to TCP window stall
description: NSS socket handshake halts indefinitely if ClientHello extension split across MSS boundaries receives out-of-order ACK on cellular interfaces.
fix_patch_summary: Configured non-blocking TCP socket timeout fallback timer (5000ms) with automatic retry using standard MSS clamping.

title: IndexedDB quota exceeded error during heavy offline cache sync without quota warning
description: IDBTransaction aborts abruptly with UnknownError / QuotaExceededException when origin storage surpasses temporary storage threshold without triggering evictor callbacks.
fix_patch_summary: Emit proactive QuotaExceededError with usage metrics before transaction failure and trigger LRU eviction asynchronously.
